title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Spearow 151 021/165 Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Japanese Spearow 021/165 SV2a 151 Reverse Holo Pokemon Card is a must-have for any collector or enthusiast of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. This card features Spearow, a Stage 1 Pokémon character, and is part of the 151 set. The card is written in Japanese language and has a card number of 021/165. 

In addition, this card has a Reverse Holofoil design, which adds a unique touch to the card's overall look. It is perfect for adding to your collection or for use in competitive play. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare and sought-after card.
